description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news, which extends a base URI scheme class to handle 'news' (Usenet) URI validation as per RFC 1738. It specifies properties related to browsing and host omission, and provides a validation method that resets URI components to ensure proper validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_news
classes.description: A class representing the 'news' URI scheme handling, extending the base URI scheme class to validate news (Usenet) URIs according to RFC 1738.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the given URI object by resetting userinfo, host, port, and query components, and returns true if validation passes.
